We got list of templates. Need one that matches our target. The first template seems to be a Heck-type: breaks I-aryl and forms C=C with vinyl. The retro_smarts_template: '[C:4]=[C;H0;D3;+0:5](-[c:6])-[c;H0;D3;+0:1](:[c:2]):[c:3]>>I-[c;H0;D3;+0:1](:[c:2]):[c:3].[C:4]=[CH;D2;+0:5]-[c:6]'

That seems appropriate: product is substituted alkene with aryl groups; reactants are aryl iodide and vinyl aryl (with H). So we can use template_id 110505.

Now we need to construct JSON route: root mol target, child reaction with template_id 110505, children are two mol nodes: aryl iodide and vinyl aryl.

We should verify that applying template yields target. Use apply_template to confirm.
